summary: President Mohamed Muizzu sent Parliament three names for the vacant post of Deputy Commissioner General of Taxation at the Maldives Inland Revenue Authority (MIRA), under the Tax Administration Act (Law No. 3/2010). The Economic Committee found that two candidates met the legal requirements, interviewed them, and scored them. Only Ahmed Shafneez passed the 75% threshold, so the committee recommended him. Parliament approved him on 19 October 2026.
keyPoints: Nominees: Ahmed Shafneez (S. Hulhudhoo), Ahmed Mausoom and Mariyam Jaidha (K. Dhiffushi).
Ahmed Shafneez and Ahmed Mausoom met the legal requirements and were interviewed on 12 October 2026.
Average interview scores: Ahmed Shafneez 96.2%, Ahmed Mausoom 73.9% (75% needed).
No public complaints were received during the 6 to 11 October 2026 notice period.
outcome: Approved by Parliament: Ahmed Shafneez appointed Deputy Commissioner General of Taxation
